primary_task: Upgrade an Expo project to the latest Expo SDK: run `npx expo install expo@latest` and `npx expo install --fix`, run `npx expo-doctor`, clear caches, and apply the housekeeping and deprecated-package changes to the project files.

requirements.name: node/npx (expo CLI from npm)
requirements.evidence:
1. Upgrade Expo and dependencies ... npx expo install expo@latest
npx expo install --fix
requirements.basis: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads), build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh, start and stop local servers inside the session; network requests reach only the allow-listed hosts

requirements.name: registry.npmjs.org
requirements.basis: the package registries and hosts pypi (PyPI), npm, GitHub (github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com), Ubuntu (apt archives), NuGet and the Go module proxy are open

requirements.name: expo-doctor
requirements.basis: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads), build, test, run CLIs and scripts

requirements.name: watchman
requirements.evidence: 3. Clear caches and reinstall ... watchman watch-del-all
requirements.basis: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)

requirements.name: exp.host
requirements.evidence: Check if latest is beta: https://exp.host/--/api/v2/versions (look for `-preview` in `expoVersion`)
requirements.basis: other hosts are refused (for example huggingface, Microsoft Learn and Azure, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA)

requirements.name: expo.dev
requirements.evidence: Review release notes for the target SDK version at https://expo.dev/changelog
requirements.basis: egress_deny: "expo.dev"; other hosts are refused (for example huggingface, Microsoft Learn and Azure, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA)

requirements.name: cocoapods / Xcode (pod install, npx expo run:ios)
requirements.evidence: These steps only apply when `ios/` and/or `android/` directories exist in the project: - Clear the cocoapods cache for iOS: `cd ios && pod install --repo-update` - Clear derived data for Xcode: `npx expo run:ios --no-build-cache`
requirements.basis: Windows or macOS, and their GUI toolchains (Xcode, Visual Studio, PowerShell on Windows)

requirements.name: gradle (./gradlew clean)
requirements.evidence: Clear the Gradle cache for Android: `cd android && ./gradlew clean`
requirements.basis: Manifest does not say whether the Gradle wrapper can download its distribution (services.gradle.org is not in the allow-list) or whether an Android SDK/JDK is present; would need to check.

requirements.name: submit-expo-feedback (Expo feedback endpoint)
requirements.evidence: npx --yes submit-expo-feedback@latest --category skills --subject "expo-upgrade" "<actionable feedback>" ... Only submit when you have something specific and actionable to report.
requirements.basis: forbid_effects: "writes_external"; other hosts are refused (for example huggingface, Microsoft Learn and Azure, Cloudflare, Expo, Neon and NVIDIA)

notes: Read literally, the required steps (npx expo install, npx expo install --fix, npx expo-doctor, cache clears, editing app.json/babel/metro/postcss/package.json) use npm packages and local files; the document never states that these commands contact Expo servers, so no hard requirement is unavailable. The beta check at exp.host, the release-notes review at expo.dev/changelog, the bare-workflow iOS/Android cache steps and the feedback submission are conditional or optional. Other reading: `npx expo install` and `expo-doctor` query Expo's versions API (an Expo host, refused by the proxy); if that network call is counted as hard and the CLI cannot fall back to the bundled dependency map, the verdict would be BLOCKED on egress:expo-api. If the release-notes review at https://expo.dev/changelog is treated as a required housekeeping step, it would also be BLOCKED (egress:expo.dev). `npx expo export -p ios` bundles JS only and does not need Xcode. Unknown: Gradle wrapper download for bare Android projects.
